news.headline: Nvidia's CEO Scandal Adds Risk, But Loose Policy Says The AI Boom Isn't Over
news.summary: Nvidia's board opened an independent investigation into Jensen Huang. On Oct 28, the day before the story ran, NVDA traded at $220. At the lows on Monday, it was 23% below that Oct 28 level.

news.headline: What Midterm Results Mean For Policy And Data Center Risk
news.summary: A divided government makes major federal policy changes unlikely. The election leaves our broad market outlook unchanged, while adding political and execution risks to watch into 2027.

news.headline: A Reset Is Not The End Of The AI Story
news.summary: The AI build has seemed due for a reset. We saw those worries translate into a sharp market selloff. But it doesn't change our longer-term view that AI represents a powerful investment theme
